name: IBlogPictureExtensibility
description: Represents an object that provides the ability to manipulate blog images.
remarks: Pictures are stored with picture providers in an account set up by the user.

methods.name: BlogPictureProviderProperties
methods.description: Enables picture providers to offer themselves as an upload location for blog pictures.

parameters.name: BlogPictureProvider
parameters.description: The ID of the picture provider.

parameters.name: FriendlyName
parameters.description: The friendly name of the picture provider.

methods.name: CreatePictureAccount
methods.signature: CreatePictureAccount(Account As String, BlogProvider As String, ParentWindow As Long, Document As Object)
methods.description: Allows a picture provider to display the user interface needed to guide the user through setting up a picture account.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: Represents the GUID of the account registry key. Blog account settings are stored in the registry at \\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\Common\Blog\Account.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Contains the HWND for the window that Microsoft Word is calling from.

methods.name: PublishPicture
methods.signature: PublishPicture(Account As String, ParentWindow As Long, Document As Object, Image As IUnknown, PictureURI As String, ImageType As Long)
methods.description: Used to post a picture object to its final destination in a blog.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: Represents the GUID of the account registry key. Blog account settings are stored in the registry at \\HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\Common\Blog\Account.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Contains the HWND for the window that Microsoft Word is calling from.

parameters.name: Image
parameters.description: Represents the name of the image file.
